Write and refactor code across your codebase

text: Type # and describe a command in natural language to have the matching shell command generated in real time

text: Prevent sensitive Blocks from being saved locally, or clear Blocks from a machine entirely

text: Secret redaction is always applied in AI interactions so sensitive data isn't sent to third parties
quote: Warp unconditionally applies Secret Redaction in all AI interactions to ensure that any sensitive data is _never_ collected or sent to third parties.

text: Opt out of telemetry at any time

text: Monitor outgoing telemetry in real time with a native Network Log and a published list of telemetry events
quote: Read a complete list of all the telemetry events that get sent for app analytics ... Opt out of telemetry at any time

text: Automatically generate new themes from a background image

text: Warp client source code is open under the AGPL v3 license
quote: Read and audit Warp’s client source code at `warpdotdev/warp`, open source under AGPL v3

quote: API, CLI, SDK and MCP built as a platform, not a vertical product or AI teammate.
